configurations.name: hugo-lan
runtimeArgs: IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 || ipconfig getifaddr en1); if [ -z "$IP" ] || [ "$IP" = 192.0.0.2 ]; then IP="[$(ifconfig en0 | awk '/inet6 .*autoconf secured/{print $2; exit}')]"; fi; hugo server -D --bind :: --port "$PORT" --appendPort=false --baseURL "http://$IP:$PORT"
